summary: Glades County steel lookout erected in 1960; dismantled and moved to a new location in Tennessee in February 2015. No source describes the original site today.

facts.status_note: Dismantled and moved to a new location in Tennessee in February 2015; the Tennessee site is not named.

events.note: Dismantled and moved to a new location in Tennessee; the source does not name the location.

evidence.supports: dismantled in February 2015 and moved to Tennessee
evidence.quote: February 2015: The tower was dismantled and moved to a new location in Tennessee.

corrections.why: The source says the tower was dismantled and moved to a new location in Tennessee in February 2015. It was moved, not lost, so the record's gone status is wrong.

notes_for_editor: Single source, a lookout-history site with a two-line entry. The Tennessee location is not named, and a search turned up no other account of the move, so the 'relocated' status rests on this one page. The height of 30.5 m is converted from the source's '100-foot'. No photos found. The Glades County site's current condition is not described by any source read.
